children: China banking group's interim net interest income grew 8.6% yr/yr to RMB 92.6 bln
Net income attributable to shareholders rose 4% yr/yr to RMB 47.9 bln
Earnings per share declined 11.9% yr/yr to RMB 0.52
Bank did not provide specific financial guidance or outlook for the current or future periods
NET INTEREST INCOME - Co said net interest income rose 8.6% to RMB 92.6 bln, with margin up 2 bps to 1.23%, driven by refined pricing, deposit-loan management and long-term deposit repricing
CUSTOMER DEPOSITS - Deposits from customers increased 6.5% yr/yr to RMB 9.92 trln
COST EFFICIENCY - Business costs fell 2.08%, lowering cost-to-income ratio to 27.47% from 29.94%
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 9 "strong buy" or "buy", 3 "hold" and 2 "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the banks peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Bank of Communications Co Ltd is HK$8.60, about 14.1% above its August 27 closing price of HK$7.54
The stock recently traded at 6 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 6 three months ago
